messages.content:
Risk: Governance failure
Description: Inadequate regulatory frameworks and oversight mechanisms failing to keep pace with AI development, leading to ineffective governance and the inability to manage AI risks appropriately.
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 9/19 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 5/19 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 3/19 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 3/19 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 2/19 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language

axes.rationale: The risk of governance failure involves the agents responsible for creating and enforcing regulatory frameworks. These agents are crucial in managing AI risks appropriately.
Inadequate governance can lead to algorithmic discrimination due to insufficient oversight, making it a key object of concern in the context of AI governance failure.
